description: Defines a thread-compatible periodic sampler class with methods for probabilistic sampling, including base class and template implementation with thread-local global period control.

classes.name: PeriodicSamplerBase
classes.description: Base class providing probabilistic sampling logic with thread safety and inline optimization support.

classes.name: PeriodicSampler
classes.description: Template class implementing a thread-local periodic sampler with configurable global period.

methods.name: Sample
methods.description: Returns true roughly once every 'period' calls based on internal stride logic.

methods.name: SubtleMaybeSample
methods.description: Spuriously returns true, used for optimized sampling paths.

methods.name: SubtleConfirmSample
methods.description: Confirms whether a sample decision is valid, used with SubtleMaybeSample.

methods.name: GetExponentialBiased
methods.description: Virtual method to get the next stride, for testing purposes.

methods.name: period
methods.description: Returns the current sampling period, thread-safe.

methods.name: SetGlobalPeriod
methods.description: Sets the global sampling period for the template instance, thread-safe.
